entities.name: Saprazzo
entities.description: Island city of merfolk and humans on Mercadia, within a volcanic caldera lake.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight, wounded in Saprazzo.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: Healer of the Weatherlight crew, imprisoned in a plot.

entities.name: Cho-Manno
entities.description: Believed dead, he returns and proves Orim's innocence.

entities.name: Lahaime
entities.description: Leader of the Ramosians who stages his own execution.

entities.name: Oustrathmer
entities.description: Saprazzan conspirator plotting to steal the Matrix.

entities.name: Power Matrix
entities.description: Artifact the crew seeks in Saprazzo.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: Legendary artificer-turned-god who shattered into five artifacts.

entities.name: Bones of Ramos
entities.description: Five sacred artifacts left from Ramos.

entities.name: Ramosians
entities.description: Followers led by Lahaime, allied against Mercadia.

events.summary: Sisay, Orim and Hanna arrive in Saprazzo seeking the Power Matrix; Sisay is wounded after a sailor harpoons a Breaker and Orim heals her.
events.quote: only to be saved by Orim, who called for peace and used her healing abilities to restore her captain.

events.summary: The vizier tells the myth of Ramos but postpones deciding about the Matrix.
events.quote: the vizier hesitated, postponing the decision.

events.summary: Orim discovers a plot to steal the Matrix and frame the crew, and is imprisoned, falsely accused.
events.quote: Orim was ambushed and imprisoned, falsely accused of murder and theft.

events.summary: Cho-Manno appears with Lahaime and proves Orim's innocence by mind meld.
Lahaime stages his own execution to feed the Mercadians false intelligence; the crew gets safe passage back to Mercadia.
events.quote: Lahaime staged his own "execution" before Oustrathmer

relations.quote: scheming to steal the Matrix and frame the Weatherlight crew for the crime
revealing their survival and their alliance against Mercadia
is the island city of merfolk and humans on the plane of Mercadia .
